title: Bearcat cooling model: data and assumptions
extraction: All source rows retained at their recorded time resolution. Only seven calculation channels are packaged for this app; all 40 original channels remain in Raw 01–19 column H of the workbook. No smoothing or resampling is used for calculations.
sourceRowLookup: For a run, original CSV line = zero-based JSON row index + originalCsvFirstDataLine. Global raw row ID = zero-based JSON row index + firstGlobalRawRowId. Block = floor((global raw row ID - 2)/20000) + 1; worksheet row = ((global raw row ID - 2) mod 20000) + 2.

channels.note: Gauge interpretation is a model assumption.
Absolute interpretation is a model assumption.
No voltage channel in these 18 files. Missing, not zero. Baseline uses assumed 14 V.

calibration.currentFlowSource: Keenan reported Andrew repeated an injector flow test and instructed use of 230 cc/min per injector. Static fully open interpretation and 47 psi differential test pressure remain assumed, pending confirmation.
calibration.densitySource: THE Excel Sheet.xlsx, Fuel Used & Heat Rej.!E10:E11: 6.15 lb/US gal and conversion to 736.9325445 kg/m³. Inherited property, not a certificate for the actual fuel.
calibration.lhvSource: THE Excel Sheet.xlsx, Fuel Used & Heat Rej.!E44:E46: inherited 114,000 BTU/US gal converted using the same fuel density. Exact fuel product/LHV not confirmed.
calibration.supersededFlowSource: ER180201 injector bench report, Raw Data!R23:T24, 328 g in one minute at Raw Data!R5 = 47 psi. Keenan identified this older flow datasheet as incorrect. Retained only for historical reproduction.
calibration.deadtimeSource: Old injector bench Raw Data!D42:T43, copied into Source Register!V2:W18. PE3 screenshot corroborates programmed rounded values, not physical validity with the revised injector flow.

formulas.equation: qRef_g_min = injector_cc_min * density_g_cc; q_g_min = qRef_g_min * sqrt(deltaP / referencePressurePsi)
Deff = max(Dcmd - subtractDeadtime * deadtime_ms * max(RPM, 0) * injectionsPer720 / 120000, 0)
Pavg = integral(fuel_kW dt) / valid_interval_seconds; integrate piecewise-linear power with interpolated window boundaries.
coolant_kW = average_fuel_kW * coolantFraction; with_margin_kW = coolant_kW * safetyFactor

assumptions: Both injectors share the one logged pulse width and static flow. Separate cylinder or staged injector operation is not measured by this channel.
One injection per 720 degrees is the historical convention. Pulse count and logged PW definition must match the actual ECU strategy.
Opening delay is subtracted only under the assumption that logged PW includes it. The 95% commanded duty cap is a working model assumption, not a verified firmware limit.
Coolant fractions 25–40% are sensitivity inputs, not measured engine fractions or radiator efficiencies.
SF 1.2 is a separate 20% engineering margin, not a measured uncertainty bound.

Time-weighted means include all valid time in the selection. Moving intervals require both endpoints above 5 mph and at least 1000 rpm. Neither a filename nor the moving filter identifies clean endurance laps.
The baseline splits gaps greater than 0.05 seconds, time resets, duplicates, and file boundaries. Windows never bridge these breaks.
